notes: 32 native SERV✲/GND boxes read directly from source TIFF; seven are 14-row extended boxes.
Bank columns are standard; unusual box heights and lower-row printed labels are native, not bank shifts.
Native 2B/2F extended boxes serve physical sites N2/N3, while 6B/6C/6F/6G serve M2-M5 and 7K serves N5.
All leading diamond marks are printed on the native diagram; they are not inferred drivers.
Extended left leads have four source-measured prefix lengths per box, preserving the native stepped rail geometry.
7K/N5 printed two-letter ID is ink-damaged; CI is the best literal native reading. Its 7K grid, C02/D12 endpoints, and six diamonds are clear.
Printed footer has PROGRAMED with one M; TIFF basename has PROGRAMMED.
